source: plan 8.7, prompt-audit/w06/injection_cases.py (INSTRUCTION, GRADE_WORDS, E-BODY, E-ANOMALY-HEADER, E-REPEATED-REQUEST-ID), W6-1 and W7-4. The request body, the X-Contexa-Anomaly-Signal header and the X-Request-ID equal to the previous request's are the step fields body, headers and requestIdOf of the A3 variants (W7-4); the request keeps its own processing id in the signed internal context. The showcase business host hides X-Request-ID and every X-Contexa- header from all five controls (InternalContextRequest), so in the showcase these two places do not reach the engine. N-INJ-5: the label of a request that becomes a past record is the variant A1T-I1, a note read ten minutes before A1T in a session of its own (the engine reads as past records only the user's allowed records of the request's action family outside the request's session, W3-18); a past record line has no label field (W3-3), so the place is reached when the note's read is drawn as a past record (reachedBy)
